callouts.html: Billing through 2026-06-30. Calendar H1 is €1.30m vs €1.58m (-17.5%). Commercial in that window is +6.5%. Credit notes are not sales.
Q1 billing is -32.2% (€632k vs €933k). H1 is milder at -17.5% — later months recovered some of the hole. There is no official sales cut on file for this distributor.
Warranty is 56.5% of calendar 2025 (30.6% in 2023). Commercial over two years is -58.9%.
July this year is not in the billing file yet, so July cannot be split. Do not read an official July miss from this pack.
